focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text/numbers on the dial face (via detection failure).
Structural integrity and attachment point of the side thermometer (boundary separation).
Sharpness of the boundary between the wooden casing and the background wall.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the dial. AI models often struggle with rendering precise numerical scales and small print. Verify if the numbers follow a logical progression (e.g., 960, 970, 980...) or if they are nonsensical symbols. Also, examine the connection point of the small thermometer on the left; ensure it has a plausible physical mounting mechanism and does not appear to melt into the wood frame. Prioritize checking if the open_vocabulary_detector can successfully isolate individual numbers; failure to do so is strong evidence of AI generation.
image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a vintage aneroid barometer. The instrument features a dark, polished wooden casing with a distinctively shaped, slightly squared-off circular profile. The central dial is brass or gold-toned with black numerical markings and a pointer hand. To the left of the main dial, there is a smaller vertical thermometer attached to the casing. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.
